title: 第23章 香味第24章 成了
slug: 绑定生子系统后我御兽封神
content_zh:
第23章香味
“大师兄，你先走，我过去一趟。”宋荞说着，毫不犹豫朝着密林深处冲去。
求偶期的神兽，处于最暴躁也最难受的状态。
这个时候，如果有人能够安抚他们的这种不安和躁动，神兽对这个人的信任度定然会大大提升。
生子丹的作用她是知道的，但是月光猫不知道。
她要让月光猫信任她，要让月光猫吃下生子丹，这就是最好的机会。
“宋师妹！”黎漠的神情不由变了，他一把拉住宋荞的手臂：“不可！神兽大人这些年越发暴躁，尤其是这个时候。一旦靠近，不死也是伤！”
“宿主啊，黎漠说的对啊。”系统苦口婆心的声音响了起来：“和神兽打交道，可不是一件容易的事。一旦惹到他们，你分分钟可能没命。还是听我的，自己吃算了。其实我觉得黎漠对你挺有意思的，你不如就把他勾搭上，然后……”
这系统，真是学不乖！
宋荞随手静音，然后定定地看着黎漠：“大师兄，不必管我。我有非去不可的理由。”
她既然来了这个世界一趟，是一定要站到巅峰的。
但她现在的资质并不允许。
与其真的听系统的话，去做一个生子工具。不如为了自己搏一把！
和实力远胜于她的神兽打交道，哪怕她精通动物心理，风险依旧很大。
毕竟，这是传说中的神兽，吹一口气，都能让她灰飞烟灭的存在。
可，她必须要搏这一次。
宋荞的神情格外坚定，没有一丝一毫的动摇。
黎漠怔忡了一下，旋即说道：“好，那我同你一起去。”
宋荞愣了一下：“大师兄，不必如此的。”
此事，她并没有百分百的把握。

“你确定要跟我在这里浪费时间？”黎漠看了她一眼。
宋荞：“……”
她咬了咬牙：“好，那就一起，大师兄，我一定尽力护你周全。”
说着，宋荞毫不犹豫，朝着密林深处狂奔而去。
黎漠的眸光微微闪动了一下。
护他周全……
师尊告诉他，他是宗门大师兄，要承担起宗门的责任，保护好师弟师妹们。
长老们告诉他，他是宗门大师兄，要做好宗门弟子的表率。
师弟师妹们，也都崇敬着他仰望着他。
这似乎还是第一次……有人说，要护他周全。
黎漠的唇角，泛起一丝微不可查的笑容，然后他上前，一把拉住宋荞的手。
宋荞看向他。
content_en:
Chapter 23 Fragrance
"Senior Brother, you go first, I'll go over there." Song Qiao said, rushing towards the depths of the dense forest without hesitation.
The mythical beast in the courtship period is in the most violent and uncomfortable state.
At this time, if someone can calm their uneasiness and restlessness, the trust of the mythical beast in this person will definitely be greatly improved.
She knew the effects of the fertility pill, but Moonlight Cat didn't.
She wants Moonlight Cat to trust her and let Moonlight Cat eat the fertility pill. This is the best chance.
"Junior Sister Song!" Li Mo's expression couldn't help but change, and he grabbed Song Qiao's arm: "No! The sacred beast has become more and more violent in recent years, especially at this time. Once you get close, you will be injured even if you don't die!"
"Host, Li Mo is right." The system's earnest voice rang out: "Dealing with mythical beasts is not an easy task. Once you mess with them, you may die in minutes. It's better to listen to me and take care of yourself. In fact, I think Li Mo is quite interesting to you. Why don't you hook up with him, and then..."
This system is really hard to learn!
Song Qiao muted his voice and then looked at Li Mo steadily: "Elder brother, don't worry about me. I have a reason to go."
Since she came to this world, she must stand at the top.
But her current qualifications don't allow it.
Instead of really listening to the system, make a fertility tool. Why not give it a try for yourself!
Even if she is proficient in animal psychology, dealing with a mythical beast that is far more powerful than her is still very risky.
After all, this is a legendary beast that can make her disappear into ashes with just one breath.
But, she must fight this time.
Song Qiao's expression was extremely determined, without wavering at all.
Li Mo was stunned for a moment and then said: "Okay, then I'll go with you."
Song Qiao was stunned for a moment: "Elder brother, it doesn't have to be like this."
She was not 100% sure about this matter.
"Are you sure you want to waste time here with me?" Li Mo glanced at her.
Song Qiao: "..."
She gritted her teeth: "Okay, then let's go together, senior brother, I will try my best to protect you."
With that said, Song Qiao didn't hesitate and ran towards the depths of the dense forest.
Li Mo's eyes flickered slightly.
Protect him well...
The master told him that he was the eldest brother of the sect and he had to shoulder the responsibilities of the sect and protect his junior brothers and sisters.
The elders told him that he was the eldest brother of the sect and he should set a good example for the disciples of the sect.
The junior brothers and sisters also respected him and looked up to him.
This seems to be the first time...someone said that he should be protected.
An undetectable smile appeared on the corners of Li Mo's lips, and then he stepped forward and took Song Qiao's hand.
Song Qiao looked at him.
